spaceships.name: Nigeria’s Massive Yet ‘Invisible’ Economic Engine Is Running On Empty
spaceships.description: Launched in 2016, AHANSA Business Centre is situated in Westlands. It strives to provide a full serviced business environment with leading-edge IT-service type solutions. It offers full reception services inclusive of couriering / mailing of packages, emailing, faxing, photocopying, printing, etc. In-house catering and lounge services for its members and clients along with the regular offering of meeting and conference rooms access. Available facilities : photocopier/printer/scanner, Integrated
